params.body:
Refs #658

## What was wrong

A car with a Car-Pass link but no stored PDF shows the "Car-Pass" chip in the list. A click on that chip gave a 404, "no PDF". Such a car comes from one of three places:
- a partner (Hexon) that sends `main.carpass` (R P3-2.6, R P3-2.14);
- a link the dealer pasted after Car-Pass issue 150 (R S3-3.10, #1064);
- a confirmed unknown chassis number, where Car-Pass returns a public URL without a file (R S3-8.1).

Two cars of one garage became such cars today, so the dead end is no longer rare.

In the third case the click did not even give a 404. Car-Pass stores that report without a `file` key. `getPdf` read `$data?->file` on the right of `??`, which reads a missing property, so the click gave a **500**.

## What changes

- **The chip opens the report at Car-Pass** (`CarpassController::getPdf`, R S3-4.8). When there is no stored PDF, or the success row carries no readable file, the route redirects to the car's `carpass_id`. Only a link of a Car-Pass report is followed (`CarpassLink::normalize`); any other link stays a 404. A PDF that exists still wins (R S3-4.2).
- **No more 500 on a row without `file`.** The file is read in one `??` chain. Rewriting that line removes one entry from `phpstan-baseline.neon`.

## Not in this change

#658 asks for the PDF itself on the sheet of a car that came in through Hexon. The platform still has no PDF for such a car, because only the garage's own Car-Pass account can fetch it. This change opens the public report instead, so the issue stays open.

## Tests

- `CarpassPdfResponseTest` has two new tests: a car with only a link opens the report, both without a success row and with a success row that has no file; and a link outside Car-Pass, or a row without `file` and no usable link, is a 404 and not a 500. The first fails on `main`, with a 500 on the row without `file`.
- PHPStan and the rule tests pass. In the full suite locally, the only failure is `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`. It also fails here without this change, and it passed in CI on #1064.
params.title: Open the Car-Pass report when a car has a link but no stored PDF
